result.summary: The page is mostly coherent, but there are a few visible content/layout issues: duplicate restaurant cards in the “Fastest near you” row, clipped/truncated carousel content at the right edge, and partially cut-off content near the bottom that may look broken without clearer scroll affordance.

issues.description: The first two “Fastest near you” cards appear to be exact duplicates: same “Green Bowl Poké” name, same image, same 15–25 min time, and same €0.90 delivery fee.
issues.suggestion: Verify the feed data and de-duplicate restaurant entries; if they are different locations, show distinguishing info such as address, distance, or branch name.

issues.description: The rightmost category chip and the “Smash Bros Bu…” card are clipped by the screen edge, making the horizontal list look accidentally cut off rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer horizontal scroll affordance, edge fade, peek spacing, or ensure truncated titles use ellipsis consistently within fully visible cards.

issues.description: The lower “Popular right now” card is partially cut off at the bottom of the viewport, which can appear like a rendering crop issue on first load.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for scrollable content, but consider adding a subtle bottom fade or ensuring the next card peeks enough to signal scrollability.

issues.description: Secondary metadata such as delivery fees and time ranges use small gray text that may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Increase font size slightly and/or raise contrast of secondary text while preserving the visual hierarchy.
